observation.visible_scene: A stainless steel saucepan sits on a black glass stovetop, filled with a vigorously bubbling amber / golden-brown liquid (syrup- or caramel-like). A clear glass bowl is partly visible at the left edge, and a brushed-steel control panel with a black knob is at the right. A bright specular highlight from overhead light reflects off the liquid surface and the pot's interior walls.
visible_changes: The liquid boils continuously throughout the excerpt: bubbles form, swell, and pop across the surface, with the foamy ring at the liquid's edge churning.
The camera gradually pulls back / zooms out, so the pot shrinks in frame and more of the surrounding stovetop and the left glass bowl become visible by the later frames.
The reflected highlight shifts position on the liquid and the pot's inner wall as the viewpoint changes.
The liquid's overall color remains amber/golden-brown, with no visible addition of ingredients or stirring implement.
outside_clip_unknowns: What the liquid is and whether it is being stirred or heated by an unseen person.
Whether the boiling began before the clip or continues after it, and any later color/consistency change.
The exact stove setting and the contents of the glass bowl.
uncertain_details: Whether the apparent size change is a true zoom or a physical camera move-back.
Whether the liquid darkens slightly over time or only the lighting/reflection changes.
